name: CD79a molecule

function.text: CD79A encodes b-cell antigen receptor complex-associated protein alpha chain. Annotated molecular activities include transmembrane signaling receptor activity. It participates in B cell activation and B cell differentiation.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to agammaglobulinemia 3, autosomal recessive (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
